messages.markdownviewer.title: Documentation
messages.markdownviewer.notConfigured: The documentation is not available yet. A developer has to set the source directory in the settings.
messages.markdownviewer.denied: You need documentation access to generate the static pages.
messages.markdownviewer.manage.title: Documentation generator
messages.markdownviewer.manage.intro: Generates a static website from the Markdown files of the source directory into the output directory. Both directories are set in the markdownviewer.json tab of the settings. A source directory with one folder per language (en-US, hu-HU) is generated as one site per language.
messages.markdownviewer.manage.notConfigured: The source directory is not set or does not exist.
messages.markdownviewer.done.generated: Generated {0} pages and {1} files into {3}. {2} outdated files were removed.
messages.markdownviewer.error.generateDenied: You are not allowed to generate the documentation.
messages.markdownviewer.error.source-not-configur: The source directory is not set in markdownviewer.json.
messages.markdownviewer.error.source-missing: The source directory does not exist.
messages.markdownviewer.error.output-not-configur: The output directory is not set in markdownviewer.json.
messages.markdownviewer.error.output-overlaps-sou: The output directory and the source directory must not contain each other.
messages.markdownviewer.error.generation-failed: The static pages could not be generated. See the application log.
messages.markdownviewer.fallback: This documentation is not available in your language. It is shown in {0}.
